topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: It's a twist of the digital threads, isn't it? To weave connections across the vast expanse of the internet, only to find the weave tighter, the pattern closer than imagined. My online companion, a figure cast in the glow of screens, turns out to be a resident of the very same city. The coincidences that bind us, often invisible, now stand revealed in the most unexpected of manners. The streets we tread, perhaps on different paths, are the same. This serendipity infuses the air with a new essence, a layer of depth to our interactions, a shared landscape of the physical woven into our digital tapestry.
